follow.title: Shall we tell you when {team}'s line-ups are out?
follow.body: As soon as they are confirmed - and the result of what you save, too.

save.title: Shall we tell you when your pick is settled?
save.body: As soon as the match ends, we'll tell you how it went.

offer.rules: Never from {from} to {to}, at most {cap} a day, and you can turn them off in your profile at any time.
offer.done: Done: we'll notify you on this device.
offer.denied: You blocked PrediGol's notices in this browser. If you change your mind, allow them in its settings and turn them on in your profile, under «Notifications».
offer.failed: We couldn't turn notices on right now. You can try again from your profile, under «Notifications».
offer.installTitle: On an iPhone, notices reach the installed app

install.iosWhy: On an iPhone or iPad, notices only reach PrediGol installed on your home screen, not Safari:
install.iosIntro: On an iPhone or iPad, PrediGol installs from Safari:
install.iosStep1: In Safari, tap Share (the square with the arrow pointing up).
install.iosStep2: Scroll down and choose «Add to Home Screen». If you see «Open as Web App», leave it on and tap «Add».
install.iosStep3Notices: Open PrediGol from its icon and turn notices on in your profile, under «Notifications».
install.iosStep3: Open it from its icon: full screen, with the same account.
install.otherIntro: Installed, PrediGol opens from its icon, full screen, and its notices arrive even when it is closed.
install.accepted: Installed: open it from its icon.

bell.title: Notify me before kick-off
bell.night: This reminder arrives even at night: you asked for it.
bell.elsewhere: It will reach your devices that have notices turned on.
bell.needsDevice: To receive it, turn notices on on this device.
bell.following: Following a team (the star) orders your Home; the bell reminds you of this match.

profile.title: Notices on your devices
profile.help: The result of what you save, your teams' line-ups, one summary a day and your account. Never from {from} to {to} (except the reminders you set with a match's bell) and at most {cap} a day of results, line-ups and summaries.

status.denied: You blocked PrediGol's notices in this browser. To receive them, allow them in its settings (on Android: Settings → Apps → Chrome → Notifications; on an iPhone: Settings → Notifications → PrediGol) and come back here.
status.unsupported: This browser can't receive notices. Try Chrome, Edge or Firefox or, on an iPhone, PrediGol installed.
status.needs_install: On an iPhone or iPad, notices reach PrediGol installed.

categoryHelp.result: Whether your pick or parlay won or lost, as soon as it is settled.
categoryHelp.lineup: When a match of your teams has confirmed line-ups.
categoryHelp.digest: Once a day, in the morning: today's matches of your teams and leagues.
categoryHelp.account: The day before your membership ends and when you sign in from a new device. What matters also arrives by e-mail.

profile.noDevices: You don't receive notices on any device yet.
profile.removed: That device will no longer receive notices.
profile.testSent: Sent: it will reach your devices in a few seconds.
profile.testHelp: To check that they arrive. Up to 3 a day.
